name: lem-hcb3-diagonal-inverse
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb3-diagonal-inverse — Diagonal Ha inverse propagation: there are universal C_inv < infinity and e_inv > 0 such that, for every H-CB datum with e <= e_inv, if Ha^Q_{P,P} has level-one lower modulus at least 1/4 and is bijective at level one, then every amplification is bijective and ||((Ha^Q_{P,P})_n)^(-1)|| <= 1+C_inv*e.
